entries.en: company, companionship; to accompany
entries.notes: H 栏封/幫未定，M 栏并列 pūy、pāng 两读，R 栏 hǒng 与二者均不谐，四栏不能互证，义仅据西语词头推定。

entries.en: group, flock, company (collective numeral)
lineage branch, clan division (a house of a family)
entries.notes: 西语 continens 义晦，唯 H/M/R 三栏一致指向「房分」，故释为宗族分房。

entries.zh: 进港船帮；船主及其商伙
entries.en: company/consortium of an incoming ship; shipmaster and his partners
entries.notes: H 栏首二字带疑（幫/封、癸/發），依 M「pāng huǎt」读作「幫發船主」，义从西语 navío entrante 定。

entries.en: to form a herd/flock; to band together
entries.notes: 西语 omanada 当作「o manada」（或成群），与 H「成群」正合。

entries.en: herd-mates; companions of the same flock or group
company, squad, band (of men)
entries.notes: 西语 oquadrilla 当作「o quadrilla」（或小队、帮伙）。

entries.en: to go in company; to accompany on the way
entries.notes: 西语「irencumpania」当作「ir en compaña」，H 正作「伴行」，唯 R 栏 kêng 与 行 不谐。

entries.en: companion of a monastery; one who accompanies the monks
entries.notes: H「伴院」罕用、R 栏 xīñ 与 院 不谐，义据西语 monasterio 推定为寺院伴当。

entries.en: company of foot soldiers; infantry company

entries.zh: 匹配，使成双；（为男女）婚配
entries.en: to pair up, to match; to marry (a couple)
entries.notes: H 首字带疑（匹/巫），西语「aparea dos y casados」明指配对成婚，与「匹配」相合。

entries.en: a group of people; a crowd
to gather a group; to band together
to gather together; to assemble

entries.zh: 伙计，合伙做买卖的同伴
entries.en: partner, business partner; shop fellow, assistant
band of thieves; gang of robbers

entries.zh: 公社，会社（合伙团体）；同伙
entries.en: association, partnership, company; accomplice, partner
entries.notes: 西语作「companion in thievery」，与 H「公社」（会社）字面不合，故两义并存而不敢定于一。

entries.en: companions/associates of the master; fellow disciples
entries.notes: H/M 作「師友」，R 栏 zīñ ièn 与二字均不谐，义据西语 maestro 推定为师门伴当。

entries.en: colleague; fellow worker of the same trade or office
companion, mate
entries.notes: M 栏 Hūe 即「夥/伙」之音，H 栏「核」与 companion 义不合，当系记音借字。

entries.en: companion, mate
entries.notes: H「生/先核」与 M「lǎn huè」不能互证，首字 lǎn 未能定读，义仅据西语 companero 推定。
